lore.title: Official Lore & Background
lore.p1: Purin Kokoa is a half-cat-half-human chocolatier. She was once an abandoned cat who was warmly adopted by a skilled chocolatier.
lore.p2: Driven by deep admiration for her owner, she always dreamed of becoming a chocolatier and serving customers herself. One day while wandering, she got lost in an enchanted forest and met a purple-haired fairy godmother who offered to grant her wish.
lore.p3: ✨ She joyfully said yes, and now she is a full-fledged chocolatier running her own chocolate shop. Come and visit her cozy chocolaterie! 🍮
